titles.title: Forest Biodiversity and Clearcutting Prohibition Act of 1991
Forest Biodiversity and Clearcutting Prohibition Act of 1991

To amend the Forest and Rangeland Renewable Resources Planning Act of 1974, the Federal Land Management and Policy Act of 1976, the National Wildlife Refuge System Administration Act of 1966, the National Indian Forest Resources Management Act, and title 10, United States Code, to strengthen the protection of native biodiversity and to place restraints upon clearcutting and certain other cutting practices on the forests of the United States.
